description: This file defines a controller class for the orangeHRM system, specifically handling the saving and editing of qualification languages within the admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up the appropriate Vue component and properties based on the request data.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLanguageController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the save operation for qualification language entities, setting up the Vue component based on request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, choosing between edit and save components based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
